t: Water-based, solvent-free acrylic dispersion floor primer and bonding agent. Suitable for use prior to the application of any Bostik levelling compound. When applied undiluted it acts as a bonding agent on non-porous surfaces. In diluted form, it can be used as a primer on porous surfaces with excellent coverage rates and will dry within one hour depending on the conditions, making it ideal for fast track installations.
b: Suitable for Use with Most Common Substrates
